import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
namespace MvPolynomial.EvalTaylorProbe
#check_failure MvPolynomial.eval_taylor
#check @MvPolynomial.eval_assoc
#check @MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply
#check @MvPolynomial.eval_eval₂
variable {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
noncomputable def shift (α : σ → R) : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
  MvPolynomial.aeval fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.X j + MvPolynomial.C (α j)
theorem original (α x : σ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x (shift α P) = MvPolynomial.eval (fun j ↦ x j + α j) P := by
  simp [shift, MvPolynomial.aeval_def, ← MvPolynomial.eval_assoc, Function.comp_def]
theorem abstractLaw {τ : Type*} (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R) (x : τ → R)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C f P) =
      MvPolynomial.eval (MvPolynomial.eval x ∘ f) P :=
  (MvPolynomial.eval_assoc f x P).symm
theorem bundled (α x : σ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x (shift α P) = MvPolynomial.eval (fun j ↦ x j + α j) P := by
  simpa [shift] using MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (MvPolynomial.aeval x)
    (f := fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.X j + MvPolynomial.C (α j)) P
#print axioms original
#print axioms abstractLaw
#print axioms bundled
end MvPolynomial.EvalTaylorProbe
